exposure: Prenatal NSAID therapy (ibuprofen 400-600 mg every 8 h, indomethacin 50 mg every 8 h)
cohort: A single fetus diagnosed with severe tricuspid valve dysplasia (TVD) and a circular shunt at 22 weeks gestation.
finding: Prenatal NSAID therapy (ibuprofen and indomethacin) demonstrated potential as a therapeutic option for managing severe tricuspid valve dysplasia with a circular shunt, enabling a near-term delivery, improved fetal survival, and conservative neonatal management.
gest_age: Near term (at birth); diagnosis at 22 weeks gestation; treatment initiated at 28 weeks gestation
